packageArguments.description: Run the MCP server over stdio.
packageArguments.name: mcp

packageArguments.description: Project root this server serves. Required, and resolved once at startup: one process serves exactly one repository, so every tool call reads and writes that project's task store. Point it at your own repo.
packageArguments.name: --project

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.authentication: None. Local-first: no login is required and no API key is needed.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.longDescription: Task management for AI coding agents over MCP and CLI. Agents claim sequenced tasks, implement, and submit for review; humans get a local-first kanban board. UI annotation files tickets with selector, file and line; verification gates the review.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.releaseNote: This manifest is pinned to 0.26.0, the published version of @vibeflow-tools/cli. Verified against the installed package, not the repository: an MCP `tools/list` handshake against `@vibeflow-tools/cli@0.26.0` returns 12 tools, and those names match `packages/cli/src/mcp/manifest.ts` exactly. The `tools` count here therefore matches the README's tool table.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.transport: stdio, one process per project. An HTTP transport also exists (vibeflow serve, MCP at /api/mcp) but it is a local loopback server, not a public endpoint, so this manifest declares no remotes.

server.name: io.github.zz-plant/ambit
server.description: Capability graph of your agent stack: what it can do, what to set up next, what breaks.

packageArguments.description: Run the MCP server over stdio instead of the terminal CLI

consumes.effect: A foreign discrepancy about a capability this graph knows is recorded as evidence attributed to the sending environment. It does not move a lifecycle: a peer reporting a capability broken does not narrow a grant here, only where the check actually failed.
consumes.from: another Ambit environment, which runs the same tech tree and so names capabilities identically. A source whose system is ambit must name its instance, and cannot name this one.
consumes.how: ambit delegation ingest <file>, or a source declared with `ambit delegation source add` and read on every full verification run

org.ethotechnics.revisable-delegation.enforced: An unattended grant whose hard prerequisite is failing returns CONFIRM at every decision, whether or not any record has been written.

notEmitted.why: Ambit holds the capability and authorization steps. Its environment adapter is simulated, so an action record from here would attest to a fixture.

org.ethotechnics.revisable-delegation.note: Level 2 for a stream from a graph nobody has objected in. Every record declares standing, so a stream containing an objection and its answer measures at Level 3.
org.ethotechnics.revisable-delegation.upstream: derived at runtime from declared sources; see `ambit delegation` output. Empty until a person declares one.
